tests.name: Auth creates real local administrator, editor and ordinary user
18 tables and original niche columns remain unchanged
All bounded admin endpoints deny anonymous and nonmembers
Quick-add series persists, duplicate names and editor writes are denied
Dictionary version conflict preserves saved record
Religion dictionary uses smallint IDs, does not auto-associate or publish
Notice edits persist without adding date or price fields
New products append to own category and are searchable by internal code
Editor can read drafts but cannot reorder, view audit or alter dictionaries
Category reorder is atomic, isolated and rejects partial/cross-category/stale sets
Editor draft save is real; publication incomplete keeps old draft intact
Actual image, religious contents and offer prices publish in one transaction
Referenced media cannot be removed even with service_role
Copy endpoint validates real JWT and role before any file operation
Real server copy creates new IDs, independent private file and unpublished child records
Wrong copied-image manifest rolls back partial rows and audit after copy starts
Stale copy HTTP returns 409 without preparing or changing source
Cleanup cannot remove referenced media; unreferenced files are really deleted
Editor cleanup is denied for unreferenced files of published product
Religion hide filters public items; last required religion cannot disappear
Audit is authentic and all legacy direct-table denials remain
A real concurrent edit during file copy returns 409 and compensates prepared files
Actual Storage delete failure is reported and cleanup retry succeeds
Browser acceptance account and sample IDs are saved only in ignored local work
